ConfessionResponse.title: ConfessionResponse
ConfessionResponse.description: Immutable confession response submitted by the recipient for a specific invitation ID.

invitationId.description: Unique invitation identifier matching the document ID.

answer.description: Actual answer chosen by the recipient.

submittedAt.description: Server timestamp when the answer was submitted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was created.

InvitationOpen.title: InvitationOpen
InvitationOpen.description: Append-only event recorded when the recipient opens the invitation.

recipientName.description: Recipient name configured on the invitation.

openedAt.description: Server timestamp when the invitation was opened.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized admin UID registry managed out-of-band in Firebase Console.

/responses/{responseId}.description: Stores immutable recipient responses keyed by invitationId.

/invitation_opens/{openId}.description: Stores invitation open timestamps for the owner dashboard.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Authorizes additional owner UIDs for the private /admin dashboard.
